// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/built-ins/Date/proto-from-ctor-realm-one.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

var o = Reflect.construct(Date, [0], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(o), other.Date.prototype);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Date/proto-from-ctor-realm-two.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

var o = Reflect.construct(Date, [1970, 0], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(o), other.Date.prototype);
})();

(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

var o = Reflect.construct(Date, [0], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(o), other.Date.prototype);
})();

console.log("DS19 date complete");
